newsitem.title: MEXICO: Canada companies interested in Mexico projects.
newsitem.headline: Canada companies interested in Mexico projects.

text.p: Several Canadian firms are interested in bidding to build infrastructure projects in the central Mexican state of San Luis Potosi, state Governor Horacio Sanchez Unzueta said on Tuesday.

Sanchez Unzueta said that during a recent trip to Montreal, he told Canadian firms the state plans to allow private companies to build a 150 km toll road between the capital San Luis Potosi and Lagos de Moreno, Jalisco.
The state leader also pitched two water treatment plants that will also be up for grabs.
"There was a lot of interest in the projects," he told a news conference.
Sanchez Unzueta visited the headquarters of SNC-Lavalin Group, which he said was interested in building the two water treatment plants that will soon be opened to bidding.
He said some local producers of onion, garlic, tomato and cilantro also arranged their first export contracts to Canada.
